title: The Colony of the Kuiper Line
author: Oscar Montrose
blurb: Oscar Yarrow, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
